using System;
using System.Buffers;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Text;

namespace Garnet.common
{
    /// <summary>
    /// A span of bytes that can be used as a key or value in a store.
    /// </summary>
    public readonly struct SpanByte : IEquatable<SpanByte>
    {
        private readonly Span<byte> span;

        public SpanByte(Span<byte> span)
        {
            this.span = span;
        }

        public Span<byte> Span => span;

        public static SpanByte FromPinnedPointer(byte* ptr, int length)
        {
            return new SpanByte(new Span<byte>(ptr, length));
        }

        public static SpanByte FromPinnedSpan(Span<byte> span)
        {
            return new SpanByte(span);
        }

        public void MarkNamespace()
        {
            // Implementation here
        }

        public void SetNamespaceInPayload(int namespaceId)
        {
            // Implementation here
        }

        public override bool Equals(object obj)
        {
            return obj is SpanByte other && Equals(other);
        }

        public bool Equals(SpanByte other)
        {
            return span.SequenceEqual(other.span);
        }

        public override int GetHashCode()
        {
            return span.GetHashCode();
        }

        public static bool operator ==(SpanByte left, SpanByte right)
        {
            return left.Equals(right);
        }

        public static bool operator !=(SpanByte left, SpanByte right)
        {
            return !left.Equals(right);
        }
    }
}
